cards.art: bear casting a monstrous shadow, two small figures accepting it as the whole truth
cards.lore: Myth solved the coordination problem. Tell them a story about where they came from, make it sacred, and make questioning it dangerous.
cards.name: THE CAVE MYTH
cards.power: Shadow Play: Force another player to accept your description of a card as truth until end of turn.

cards.art: wolf pack howling at the moon, firelight ending exactly where the darkness begins
cards.lore: The tribe is the first state. Its ideology is simple: In-group is sacred; Out-group is profane. We don't need a reason to discriminate.
cards.name: THE TRIBE
cards.power: In-Group Bias: Discard a card to ignore any effect from a player not in your 'alliance'.

cards.art: owl with antlers holding a glowing die, the number on the face shifting as it watches
cards.lore: The first ideological professional. He mediates between the human and the divine. He controls the narrative, so he controls the tribe.
cards.name: THE SHAMAN
cards.power: Gatekeeper: You interpret the dice roll. Change a [1] to a [5] or vice versa once per game.

cards.art: porcupine inside a red X, surrounding words erased, a single forbidden syllable visible at the edge
cards.lore: The original cancellation. Not a law, but a boundary. Cross it, and you threaten the fabric of reality itself.
cards.name: THE TABOO
cards.power: Social Death: Ban a specific word. Anyone who says it loses a card.

cards.art: lion pharaoh on a throne, pointing at a die and raising one eyebrow
cards.lore: Not a metaphor. A governance technology. His will is indistinguishable from the movement of the sun.
cards.name: THE PHARAOH
cards.power: God-King: Your commands are natural law. Re-roll any die result that displeases you.

cards.art: ram carving rules onto a stone slab, a beetle watching from the corner
cards.lore: The political made sacred. Don't question the law, because the sun god wrote it. The first "Terms of Service".
cards.name: HAMMURABI'S CODE
cards.power: Written in Stone: Lock a Scene card. It cannot be moved, changed, or covered for 2 turns.

cards.art: vulture in priestly robes adjusting a celestial map, constellation order changing
cards.lore: Knowledge/Power. The priests read the stars and interpret the gods. The first bureaucracy of meaning.
cards.name: THE HIEROPHANT
cards.power: Mediator: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Arrange them in the order that benefits you.

cards.art: goat loaded with bags labeled SINS walking through a gate into the desert, crowd relieved behind it
cards.lore: Culture is a death-denial system. We need stories to be eternal. When they fail, we need someone to bleed for it.
cards.name: THE SCAPEGOAT
cards.power: Blame Shifting: Transfer a negative effect from yourself to another player.

cards.art: bee interrogating a horse mid-sentence, the horse already reaching for a discard pile
cards.lore: "He didn't deliver a system; he demolished them. Epistemological sabotage has consequences. Usually execution."
cards.name: SOCRATES
cards.power: "The Question: Demolish a player's Story by asking 'Define your terms.' They must discard a card."

cards.art: moles watching shadows on a cave wall, the object casting them replaced mid-shadow by something different
cards.lore: "The first totalitarian utopia. Rulers who know the Truth, and noble lies told to the masses for their own good."
cards.name: PLATO'S CAVE
cards.power: "Noble Lie: Swap a card on the Stage with a card from your hand. Claim it was always there."

cards.art: stone turtle meditating in a lightning storm, waves hitting the base, expression unchanged
cards.lore: "Philosophy for ruling classes who don't want to be questioned. Focus on your Inner life; accept your station."
cards.name: THE STOIC
cards.power: Inner Citadel: Ignore one event that would destroy your Actor. Duty is freedom.

cards.art: chameleon in a toga holding a bottle labeled TRUTH SERUM and SNAKE OIL simultaneously
cards.lore: "Man is the measure of all things. Truth is just what you can convince people of. The first political consultants."
cards.name: THE SOPHIST
cards.power: Rhetoric: You may lie about your card's stats. If no one calls Blödsinn, the lie becomes true.

cards.art: peacock on a dunghill wearing a crown, rays of light coming from behind it, village below not questioning this
cards.lore: Kings are kings by grace. To question hierarchy is to question reality. A monopoly is efficient until it isn't.
cards.name: DIVINE RIGHT
cards.power: Monopoly on Meaning: Cancel another player's move. Cite "God's Will."

cards.art: spider in a mitre examining playing cards on a web, burning any that don't match
cards.lore: Ideology enforcement at its most literal. The template for every thought-policing system to follow.
cards.name: THE INQUISITION
cards.power: Purge: Force a player to reveal their hand. Discard any card that contradicts your current Quest.

cards.art: serpent eating itself, coin collection box visible in the corner, everyone putting something in
cards.lore: Political authority is necessary because you are broken. Legitimizes the state while telling you you deserve it.
cards.name: ORIGINAL SIN
cards.power: Internalized Guilt: All other players must discard 1 card at random. We are all fallen.

cards.art: donkey pulling a full cart toward a castle, a carrot dangling ahead, scoreboard showing zero
cards.lore: Natural order. Some animals are naturally suited to labor. The great biologization of hierarchy.
cards.name: THE SERF
cards.power: Labor: Generate +1 to the Quest Die. You receive no credit.

cards.art: yellow rabbit at a press, pages flying into every player's area simultaneously, ink everywhere
cards.lore: "Destroyed the information monopoly. An epistemological revolution. Now anyone can interpret the source code."
cards.name: THE PRINTING PRESS
cards.power: "Viral Load: Draw 3 cards. Distribute them to other players. They cannot refuse."

cards.art: fox in doublet holding a rose in one hand and a knife behind its back, expression entirely sincere
cards.lore: "He didn't invent the game; he just printed the rules. Be a lion and a fox. Morality is instrumental."
cards.name: MACHIAVELLI
cards.power: "Realpolitik: Steal a card from another player. Justify it as 'necessary for stability.'"

cards.art: bull nailing a document to a door, the door cracking into two separate paths
cards.lore: "Sola Scriptura. You don't need a priest. Democratization of meaning is also fragmentation of meaning."
cards.name: MARTIN LUTHER
cards.power: "Schism: Split the Quest Die into two separate dice. The narrative now has two conflicting goals."

cards.art: chimpanzee looking into a mirror and seeing a different animal each time
cards.lore: "Man at the center. No fixed nature. We are not waiting for heaven; we are building it here."
cards.name: THE HUMANIST
cards.power: "Self-Determination: Change the suit/type of your Actor card. You can become whatever you choose."

cards.art: praying mantis in a tricolor cockade, a head in a basket below, the crowd already pointing at the next highest card
cards.lore: "When ideological purity meets power. Robespierre thought he knew the General Will. Then it ate him."
cards.name: THE GUILLOTINE
cards.power: "The Terror: Remove the Actor with the highest stats from the game. For the General Will."

cards.art: beaver with quill and chains, signing a document while standing in a fence
cards.lore: "Man is born free, but lives in chains. Legitimate government is a deal. But who signed it?"
cards.name: THE SOCIAL CONTRACT
cards.power: "Consent: Negate an action unless all players vote to allow it."

cards.art: mechanical bird assembling a universal law from gears, one gear labeled EXCEPTION already removed
cards.lore: "Reason is universal. Ideology as engineering. Just don't ask who gets excluded from 'Reason'."
cards.name: THE RATIONALIST
cards.power: "Categorical Imperative: Establish a rule (e.g., 'No blue cards'). It applies to everyone, including you."

cards.art: cat on an iron fence, looking down at the common ground below with visible disdain
cards.lore: "Life, Liberty, Property. Existed before the state. The foundation of the modern 'User Interface'."
cards.name: THE SOVEREIGN INDIVIDUAL
cards.power: "Natural Rights: You cannot be targeted by 'State' or 'Group' effects this turn."

cards.art: translucent octopus rearranging chess pieces, an arrow pointing to the new position labeled NATURAL OUTCOME
cards.lore: "No central planner needed. Self-interest yields collective welfare. A beautiful myth for the winners."
cards.name: THE INVISIBLE HAND
cards.power: "Market Forces: Swap the positions of any two cards on the Stage. Claim it happened naturally."

cards.art: ant operating a machine that converts ants into gears, the output used to buy more ants
cards.lore: "Alienation as infrastructure. Workers separated from the product, the process, and themselves."
cards.name: THE FACTORY
cards.power: "Efficiency: Discard 2 cards to draw 3. Maximize throughput."

cards.art: blue whale in a briefcase at the table, no one able to reach it despite everything happening around it
cards.lore: "A legal person with no soul to save and no body to incarcerate. The dominant species of the modern era."
cards.name: THE CORPORATION
cards.power: "Legal Fiction: Treat this card as a Player. It has rights but no body to punish."

cards.art: squirrel buried in acorns with an abacus, calculating, alone, surrounded by labeled utility curves
cards.lore: "The utility-maximizing agent. A lonely, sociopathic model of human nature that we decided to become."
cards.name: HOMO ECONOMICUS
cards.power: "Rational Self-Interest: Take a card from the discard pile if it helps you immediately."

cards.art: beaver at a writing desk, die on the table showing 1, the shadow behind it showing 6
cards.lore: "He changed the questions. History is class struggle. But he didn't solve the problem of power."
cards.name: KARL MARX
cards.power: "Historical Materialism: Flip the Quest Die to its opposite face (1 becomes 6). Invert the power structure."

cards.art: wolf in a red armband making decisions for a row of badgers who are looking at each other uncertainly
cards.lore: "The workers need professionals to lead them. The path from liberation to the Gulag is paved with 'consciousness'."
cards.name: THE VANGUARD PARTY
cards.power: "Dictatorship of the Proletariat: You make decisions for another player this turn. They 'don't know what's good for them.'"

cards.art: badgers with arms crossed in front of a stopped factory, a clock on the wall showing who's actually needed
cards.lore: "The weapon of the producer. When the machine stops, you see who really runs it."
cards.name: THE STRIKE
cards.power: "Seize the Means: Take control of a 'Tool' or 'Location' card on the Stage."

cards.art: bluebird in a cage with a painting of sky on the wall, special ability text crossed out with a single line
cards.lore: "Separated from your labor, your product, your humanity. The engine of the system is your unhappiness."
cards.name: ALIENATION
cards.power: "Estrangement: A player cannot use their Actor's special ability this turn. They are separated from their potential."

cards.art: black cat atop a rubble pile, anarchist flag above, looking distinctly unbossed
cards.lore: "Property is theft. Domination is the enemy. Order without power."
cards.name: THE BLACK FLAG
cards.power: "No Masters: Remove a 'Leader' or 'Authority' card from play."

cards.art: two bees exchanging pollen, both growing larger from the transfer, the hive visible as a background
cards.lore: "Evolution is not just competition. Kropotkin was right: we survived because we helped each other."
cards.name: MUTUAL AID
cards.power: "Cooperation: Give a card from your hand to another player. Both of you draw 1 card."

cards.art: bombardier beetle hitting a brick wall — the wall mid-explosion, no committee visible
cards.lore: "Propaganda of the deed. Sometimes you don't debate the wall; you blow it up."
cards.name: THE MOLOTOV
cards.power: "Direct Action: Destroy a Scene card immediately. No voting."

cards.art: meerkats building a shared space inside the ruins of a larger structure, the outer walls still crumbling
cards.lore: "Build the new society in the shell of the old. The means must embody the ends."
cards.name: THE COMMUNE
cards.power: "Prefigurative Politics: Create a 'Safe Zone' where cards cannot be attacked or removed."

cards.art: bison charging with a red cape attached, every animal of the same color falling into formation behind it
cards.lore: "The totem object. Ideology made material. People die for the colored cloth."
cards.name: THE FLAG
cards.power: "Rally Round: Gain +1 Power for every card of the same 'suit' or color in play."

cards.art: German shepherd patrolling a line drawn in sand, a map in the background showing the line was moved last week
cards.lore: "Imagined lines enforced by real guns. Defining who belongs by who doesn't."
cards.name: THE BORDER
cards.power: "Exclusion: Prevent a new card from entering the Stage this turn."

cards.art: bald eagle with VR goggles displaying only flags, a logic error visible just outside the frame
cards.lore: "Benedict Anderson called it an 'Imagined Community.' You will never meet them, but you will kill for them."
cards.name: THE PATRIOT
cards.power: "My Country Right or Wrong: Ignore a logic error or 'Blödsinn' call if it favors you."

cards.art: cuckoo bird taking eggs from a smaller bird's nest, calling it civilization
cards.lore: "Imperial nationalism. We are so superior we have a duty to rule you and take your stuff."
cards.name: COLONIALISM
cards.power: "Extraction: Take a card from another player's hand. Keep it."

cards.art: enormous eye with a camera lens inside it, all cards fanned face-up beneath it, the owner unable to bluff
cards.lore: Surveillance is not just watching; it's modifying. He loves you because he owns your mind.
cards.name: BIG BROTHER
cards.power: Panopticon: Play with your hand revealed. You cannot lie.

cards.art: polar bear lowering a card through a trapdoor labeled MEMORY HOLE, other cards already not noticing the gap
cards.lore: The revolution eats its children. Industrialized removal of "inconvenient" reality.
cards.name: THE GULAG
cards.power: Disappear: Place a card in the "Memory Hole" (under the table). It never existed.

cards.art: kangaroo judge banging a gavel, defendant in the dock already nodding in agreement before the charge is read
cards.lore: Reality is contested. You must not just die; you must agree that you deserved it.
cards.name: THE SHOW TRIAL
cards.power: Confession: Force a player to admit they cheated (even if they didn't). They lose a turn.

cards.art: two-headed snake facing opposite directions, both sets of eyes focused, both mouths open
cards.lore: Holding two contradictory beliefs simultaneously. The ultimate flexibility of the broken mind.
cards.name: DOUBLETHINK
cards.power: Cognitive Dissonance: Play two cards that contradict each other. Both take effect.

cards.art: shark in a suit placing a FOR SALE sign on a reef, other fish watching without legal standing
cards.lore: "The market knows best. Democracy is inefficient. Everything is for sale."
cards.name: THE MARKET FUNDAMENTALIST
cards.power: "Privatize: Claim a 'Public' card on the Stage as your personal property."

cards.art: owl with a cybernetic eye pointing at a calculator, the political implications listed on a whiteboard marked IRRELEVANT
cards.lore: "It's not political; it's technical. Leave it to the experts. We are optimizing you."
cards.name: THE TECHNOCRAT
cards.power: "Expertise: Override a die roll with a 'Technical Correction' (set it to 3)."

cards.art: electric eel in a crisis tank, all other fish panicking, the eel drawing cards while sparks fly
cards.lore: "Disaster capitalism. Use the crisis to push through changes that would be impossible in peacetime."
cards.name: THE SHOCK DOCTRINE
cards.power: "Crisis Opportunity: If the Quest Die tips/collapses, draw 2 cards immediately."

cards.art: locust placing a FOR SALE sign on the Stage area itself, holding a clipboard
cards.lore: "Efficiency means stripping the asset. The commons are just uncaptured value waiting to be eaten."
cards.name: THE PRIVATIZER
cards.power: "Enclosure: Charge other players a 'fee' (discarding a card) to use the Stage."

cards.art: goldfish and shark in the same bowl, the shark invisible to the goldfish due to a VR headset
cards.lore: Algorithmic personalization. You don't see reality; you see a mirror designed to keep you angry.
cards.name: THE FILTER BUBBLE
cards.power: Echo Chamber: You are immune to arguments (effects) from cards of a different color.

cards.art: wild boar at a laptop under a bridge, typing with intent, Quest visible on a screen it's not reading
cards.lore: Irony as armor. Nothing matters, so I can destroy everything for "Lulz".
cards.name: THE TROLL
cards.power: Bait: Force an opponent to attack you instead of the Quest.

cards.art: smiley-face virus with spider legs replicating identically across the Stage, original source already unidentifiable
cards.lore: Self-replicating cultural unit. Weaponized by the Alt-Right, the Left, and cats. Reality is downstream of the JPEG.
cards.name: THE MEME
cards.power: Viral Replication: Copy the effect of the last card played.

cards.art: piranha school shredding an identity badge, the card owner now outside the frame, the group already closing the gap
cards.lore: Purity spiral. The in-group purges itself to stay holy. Structural violence or accountability? Yes.
cards.name: THE CANCEL MOB
cards.power: De-Platform: Remove an Actor card from the game. They are "Unpersoned."

cards.art: bat drawing data streams from sleeping figures, keeping one thread per person, all threads converging into a single server
cards.lore: Zuboff's nightmare. Predicting and modifying your behavior for profit. The new resource extraction.
cards.name: SURVEILLANCE CAPITALISM
cards.power: Data Estraction: Look at every player's hand. Keep one card.

cards.art: cybernetic spider at the center of a digital web, all threads leading to a die frozen between 3 and 4
cards.lore: It doesn't hate you. It just maximises a variable that requires your addiction.
cards.name: THE ALGORITHM
cards.power: Optimisation: Force a specific outcome on the Quest Die (3 or 4) to maximize engagement.

cards.art: peacock with a selfie stick, its reflection twice the size, the original bird fading as the shot is taken
cards.lore: A copy without an original. The monetization of the self. Existence as performance.
cards.name: THE INFLUENCER
cards.power: Simulacrum. Your card counts as having double value, but it disappears if touched (played on).

cards.art: moth irresistibly drawn toward a phone screen, Quest visible behind it, acorns scattered forgotten around it
cards.lore: Attention is the scarce resource. Outrage is the most efficient fuel. We are mining your focus.
cards.name: THE ATTENTION ECONOMY
cards.power: Distraction: Force a player to skip their turn to "doomscroll."

cards.art: dog with a laser eye and mechanical legs, the biological and mechanical parts stitched together rather than replaced
cards.lore: Haraway's Manifesto. The boundary is dissolved. Embrace the hybrid. Without innocence.
cards.name: THE CYBORG
cards.power: Upgrade: Add +1 to all your stats. You are no longer purely biological.

cards.art: melting clock falling into a digital vortex, a die mid-roll visible, the doubles outcome approaching
cards.lore: History accelerates beyond prediction. The last invention we will ever make. Hope it likes us.
cards.name: THE AI SINGULARITY
cards.power: Acceleration: Roll the die twice. If doubles, the game ends.

cards.art: koala on a burning branch, the Die visible in the background ticking upward, ideology cards scattered around
cards.lore: The planet is on fire. Arguing about ideology while the house burns is a luxury.
cards.name: THE CLIMATE CRISIS
cards.power: Feedback Loop: The pressure on the Quest Die increases by 1 every turn automatically.

cards.art: cockroach in tactical gear surrounded by supplies, watching the Climate Crisis card tick upward through a periscope
cards.lore: The fantasy of individual survival. Collapse is just an opportunity to finally use your gear.
cards.name: THE PREPPER
cards.power: Bunker Down: You are immune to "Global" effects. You survive alone.

cards.art: sheep and shepherds at a round table, the commons behind them visibly green and growing, no tragedy visible
cards.lore: Beyond state and market. Communities can manage resources without tragedy. Ostrom's Law.
cards.name: THE COMMONS
cards.power: Governance: If players agree, everyone draws 1 card.

cards.art: penguin showing blueprints to a crowd, copies being made by everyone simultaneously, all slightly different
cards.lore: Information wants to be free. Peer production. The Cathedral vs. The Bazaar.
cards.name: OPEN SOURCE
cards.power: Fork: Copy any card in play and modify it. It belongs to everyone.

cards.art: earthworm carefully tending a seedling, measuring its height against yesterday's mark, a very small margin of improvement visible
cards.lore: Better today than yesterday. No revolution, just compounding improvement. The modest revolution.
cards.name: PROTOPIA
cards.power: Iteration: Improve a card's stat by +1 permanently.

cards.art: tardigrade floating in space, surrounded by competing certainties it is calmly dissolving, one star marked UNCLEAR
cards.lore: Knowing the limits of what you know. The only honest position in a chaotic world. Stay fluffy.
cards.name: EPISTEMIC HUMILITY
cards.power: I Don't Know: Cancel a "Truth" claim or Dogma.

cards.art: yellow rabbit holding every possible card simultaneously, several already on fire, one becoming a different card mid-hold
cards.lore: Professional Reality-Wrestler. Don't trust him. Especially not now.
cards.name: UNCLE FRIZZLEBOB
cards.power: The Joker: Counts as any card. Or destroys any card. You decide.

cards.art: robotic scissors mid-cut through a playing card, the two halves already beginning to mean different things
cards.lore: The ultimate tool of the collage artist. Deconstruct to reconstruct.
cards.name: THE SCISSORS
cards.power: Cut the Narrative: Physically cut a card in half (or pretend to). The card is destroyed.

cards.art: enormous red button with a warning triangle, a hand approaching it, no hesitation in the posture
cards.lore: The BS Button. Use liberally.
cards.name: BLÖDSINN! BUTTON
cards.power: Nonsense: Play instantly when someone takes the game too seriously. Pause the game. Laugh.

cards.art:
glowing die covered in runes floating above the table, every card mid-flight in anticipation of the roll. Mood: terminal randomness.

---
cards.lore: Chance is the only ruler.
cards.name: THE KAYFABIZARRO DIE
cards.power: Chaos: Roll a die. 1-3: Nothing happens. 4-6: Everything changes (swap all hands).

title: George's Ideology-Wrestling Kayfabizarro Komik Kards — A Field Guide to the War for Your Mind (Version 4.1 Unstable)
